name: Shard's Fury
disable: DC 18 Intimidation check to overpower the warshard's will, DC 18 Religion check to calm the belligerent miasma
reset: The residual energies reset after 1 hour.

items.name: Inflame Battle
items.text:
Trigger A creature rolls initiative for combat within 100 feet of the crater

---
Effect An infectious battle frenzy threatens to overtake all creatures within 100 feet of the crater, driving them to lash out at anything nearby. Affected creatures must attempt a DC 18 Will save save.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature resists the battle frenzy, but takes 1d6 fire damage from the roiling fury coursing through its blood.

Failure As success, and the creature is Slowed 1 as it fights off the frenzy.

Critical Failure The creature is Confused for 1 round.

text: Wisps of red energy and violent urges emanate from the crater.
